subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — integration action sprint & eval readiness
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire@edgepayments.com>, EdgePayments Eng <eng@edgepayments.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly check-in — integration sprint goals & eval plan prep

Hi Claire / Rajesh team,

Quick weekly MAP check-in from our side. Per last week's demo, we scoped the integration runway into four focus areas: SDK/API surface, auth & token exchange, streaming telemetry, and tool-calling (webhook/tool endpoints). Attached is an updated MAP workbook (redwood-edgepayments-map-v2.xlsx) with owners and ETA columns — please use that as the single source of truth going forward.

Key asks for this sprint (June 14–21):
- SDK: confirm platform language targets (Java + Python) and whether you want reference clients or direct SDK embed (owner: Camila).
- Auth: finalize OAuth/OIDC flow and token lifetime expectations; we proposed short-lived service tokens + refresh (owner: Karthik).
- Streaming: define acceptable latency and buffering behavior for event streams (owner: Marissa).
- Tool calling: list first three tool endpoints you need us to call and sample payloads (owner: Priyom).

Immediate next steps:
1) Claire: send confirmation on language targets and any internal SDK constraints by EOD Wed (6/16).
2) Eng: share a short diagram of the auth proxy you want to insert (Rajesh or eng@) — we can take that and map to our recommended flow.
3) Internal: we'll prepare an eval harness (prompt set + perf test) and share Drive link by Thu (6/17).

Meeting cadence: same weekly slot Wed 10am PT to review updated MAP rows and blockers. If anything urgent comes up earlier, ping me or Camila.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-edgepayments-map-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 210KB)
From: Claire Park <claire@edgepayments.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Rajesh Menon <rajesh@edgepayments.com>, eng@edgepayments.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP weekly check-in — integration sprint goals & eval plan prep

Thanks, Soojin. Quick answers inline: 

- SDK: we want both Java and Python reference clients (priority order: Java). We prefer reference clients with minimal wrappers — good for our SDK team to fork. (Claire)
- Auth: we'll use our internal OIDC provider and would like short-lived access tokens with a refresh cycle ~15m for service-to-service calls. We'll share an auth proxy diagram by EOD Thu (Rajesh).
- Streaming: target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms. We buffer up to 1s on our side; prefer low-latency push from Redwood.
- Tool calling: initial endpoints: /payments/validate, /risk/score, /merchant/lookup. Sample payloads attached in Drive.

Questions for Redwood:
1) For streaming, what are your recommended batching window options that preserve p95 SLAs?
2) For tool calling, do you support idempotency/at-least-once semantics and retries?

We'll upload the auth diagram to the Drive folder and update the MAP workbook by EOD Thu.

Claire Park
Senior Product Manager, EdgePayments
claire@edgepayments.com

On Wed, Jun 16, 2027 at 09:15 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> Sounds good — I'll draft the short-lived token flow and an HMAC fallback for webhook verification.
> Karthik
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Claire Park <claire@edgepayments.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP weekly check-in — auth flow proposal + action items

Claire / Rajesh team — attaching a lightweight auth-flow diagram (auth-flow-diagram.svg) and a short table in the MAP workbook with recommended token lifetimes and rotation cadence. Highlights: 

- Proposal: OAuth2 client credentials for server-to-server with 15m access tokens + 1h refresh window for long-running streams; fallback HMAC-signed webhooks for tool-calling where you can't complete token flow.
- Security note: we recommend rotating service keys quarterly and using your KMS for signing.
- Implementation ETA: we can ship a small reference middleware and tests by Wed (6/23) if EdgePayments provides proxy diagram and test endpoint.

Action items (updated):
- Camila: start reference client skeletons (Java first) — target PR by Tue 6/22.
- Priyom: coordinate tool-calling contract and sample responses; will draft Postman collection by Mon 6/21.
- Marissa: add streaming perf tests to the eval harness; will seed with the p50/p95 targets Claire provided.
- Karthik: deliver auth middleware PR and unit tests by 6/23 (depends on EdgePayments diagram).

I'll also add quick smoke tests for token expiry and replay to the workbook. Let me know if you want me to join your infra sync tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP weekly check-in — sprint close & next steps (finalizing eval plan)

Team — quick wrap from today's check-in: we closed the outstanding scoping questions and confirmed owners in the MAP workbook. Summary and commitments below (short):

Completed this sprint:
- Language targets confirmed (Java + Python) — Camila to open repo and seed Java skeleton (PR target 6/22).
- Auth diagram received and reviewed; Karthik to start middleware work (PR target 6/23).
- Streaming targets accepted; Marissa to seed perf tests and provide baseline numbers by next Wed (6/30).
- Tool endpoints listed; Priyom to deliver Postman collection and sample responses by 6/21 (delivered).

Open blockers:
- EdgePayments to confirm test endpoints for tool-calling (sandbox URL + API key) — Claire/Rajesh action item.
- Narrow down success criteria for eval harness (we proposed functional prompts + throughput spike tests) — need final sign-off to run formal regression.

Immediate next steps:
1) EdgePayments: share sandbox endpoints + any rate limits by EOD Tue (6/22). (Claire / Rajesh)
2) Redwood: finalize eval harness and share run schedule (Soojin/Karthik/Marissa) by Fri (6/25).
3) Commercial: I'll update the mutual action plan to reflect expected close timeline of Aug 13 — internal stakeholders, please flag if this conflicts with your timelines.

Thanks everyone for the quick turn this sprint. If nothing urgent, we'll keep the cadence to weekly Wednesday 10am PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
